recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key, overexposed portrait of a man with crossed arms in a desert landscape, featuring a mix of sharp central focus and hazy, light-leaked edges, overlaid with raw, marker-style handwriting.
coreVisualRelationships: Dark silhouette of the subject against a bright, washed-out background
Contrast between the organic, messy hair and the geometric, faint background overlays
Tension between the subject's downward gaze and the upward-reaching handwritten text
coreInvariants: Warm lens flare or light leak on the subject's right side
Faint, large-scale typographic watermarks in the background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered vertically, medium shot from waist up, occupying the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's dark shirt and crossed arms provide a heavy anchor against the light background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down to the crossed arms, then travels up to the handwritten text in the top right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant bright negative space in the upper left and right corners, creating an airy but desolate feel.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm amber and golden yellow (lens flare and horizon light)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low saturation background versus low value, medium saturation subject.

letterConstructionRules: Quick, gestural strokes with visible ink pressure
Angled, slightly italicized lean to the right
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pairing raw, aggressive handwriting with faint, large-scale sans-serif watermarks in the background for depth.
graphicDevices: Faint ghosted letters in the background
Subtle vertical and horizontal grid lines

avoid: Serif fonts for the main display

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the raw, immediate feel of the original lettering.
Maintains the organic texture and varying stroke weights.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium shot of a man with messy dark hair, wearing a dark button-down shirt, standing with arms crossed in a bright, overexposed desert at sunset. Include a warm lens flare on the right side and faint, large ghosted typographic elements in the sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add four lines of black, raw, all-caps marker-style handwriting in the upper right quadrant, tilted slightly clockwise.

verificationChecks: Does the handwriting look manual rather than digital?
Is the lens flare integrated naturally into the subject's shoulder?
Are the background ghosted letters faint enough to not distract?

adjustableVariables: Degree of overexposure in the sky
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the subject's expression remains somber/introspective.
Check that the jewelry on the wrists is visible but not overly sharp.
Verify the 'dust and scratches' texture is subtle and uniform.
Confirm the text does not overlap the subject's head.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key, desaturated desert portrait with raw, black marker handwriting placed in the upper right negative space.
